description: JSON Schema for the All The Bacteria assembly index file.

sylph_species.description: inferred species call from running sylph on the reads. This is using the “post-202505” method on all of the samples. Meaning that species calls in files from 202505 onwards are not the same as in files before 202505. See the species calls page for more details

filename_in_tar_xz.description: the FASTA filename for this sample inside the tar.xz file

tar_xz.description: the name of the tar.xz file where this sample's FASTA lives

tar_xz_size_MB.description: size of the tar_xz file in MB

title: All the Bacteria assembly index file schema
